title: Why an SEC Director Calls a WSJ Ad on Tokenized Stocks ‘Misleading’
why_it_matters: The disagreement highlights how the design of tokenized share trading, investor rights and regulatory exemptions could influence issuer participation. Selway's remarks are an interpretation of the proposed framework, not a new SEC rule or approval of any trading venue.
caption:

Why an SEC Director Calls a WSJ Ad on Tokenized Stocks ‘Misleading’

SEC trading director Jamie Selway disputed two claims in an October Wall Street Journal advertisement opposing tokenized stocks, while Securitize's Brett Redfearn discussed issuer objections and market competition.
